_comment: Rules of skill compare-deal-terms-to-benchmarks. A rule computes only if its status is VERIFIED-REOPENED or ENGINEERING RULE; a [CHECK] rule is disabled and the script prints [CHECK].

rules.reason: every deal's terms carry a source reference and date
a range needs at least the team's minimum number of deals; below it the result is 'no range'

rules.passage: A member issuing a fairness opinion must make the required disclosures; a filer summarizes the procedures, findings and bases of an outside report.
The usefulness of the market approach is constrained by the scarcity of publicly available or truly comparable deals, especially for early stage assets.

rules.reason: owner ruling V5: the adopted valuation, the choice of rate and any fairness or solvency view are human only
